rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a Protestant pastor.

example.english: The minister will officiate our wedding today.
example.traditional: 牧師今日會為我哋主持婚禮。
example.jyutping: muk6 si1 gam1 jat6 wui5 wai6 ngo5 dei6 zyu2 ci4 fan1 lai5

rows.note: Use this for the usual Hong Kong title of a government minister who heads a bureau.

example.english: The minister will explain the new policy to the Legislative Council tomorrow.
example.traditional: 局長聽日會向立法會交代新政策。
example.jyutping: guk6 zoeng2 ting1 jat6 wui5 hoeng3 lap6 faat3 wui2 gaau1 doi6 san1 zing3 caak3

rows.note: Use this mainly for a foreign or historical cabinet minister in formal or written contexts.

example.english: The foreign minister announced his resignation at the meeting.
example.traditional: 嗰位外國大臣喺會議上宣布辭職。
example.jyutping: go2 wai2 ngoi6 gwok3 daai6 san4 hai2 wui6 ji5 soeng6 syun1 bou3 ci4 zik1

rows.note: Use this when translating a government title that is specifically called 部長, rather than the usual Hong Kong title 局長.

example.english: The South Korean foreign minister visited Hong Kong today.
example.traditional: 韓國外交部長今日到訪香港。
example.jyutping: hon4 gwok3 ngoi6 gaau1 bou6 zoeng2 gam1 jat6 dou3 fong2 hoeng1 gong2
